context_diary: I learned that to find a currency agent, I use account_lookup with type CURRENCY_AGENT and specify the currency. Once I have the agent's ID, I can use traverse_hierarchy with direction "children" to discover all accounts assigned to that agent. The system imposes output limits to prevent overload, so the returned count may be smaller than the total matches available. The hierarchy includes both USER and AGENT type accounts with various statuses. This workflow applies to any currency agent lookup and hierarchy traversal in the system. I also confirmed that currency agents can exist with zero assigned accounts, which is a valid state in the platform.
